brief.headline: Ask for a 10–15% price cut — they keep 8.5% profit vs. 4.8% typical, so there's room

priceAsk.summary: Push for a 10–15% price reduction on rigid plastic packaging
priceAsk.target: Benchmark to the market ask band of ₹0.65–0.80/pc at higher volume
priceAsk.basis: They keep 8.5% profit vs. 4.8% for similar firms — a 3.7 percentage-point cushion. Market research shows modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80/pc at higher volume or looser specs. Their comfortable profit margin means a price cut won't hurt them.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 45 days to 30 days after receipt
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Frees up ₹2.15 L cash for us — money we can use elsewhere instead of waiting an extra 15 days

brief.financialLeverage: Triveni is healthy — score 70/100, zero debt (0.00x), keeps 8.5% profit — but we're tiny to them at 0.15% of their ₹179.69 Cr revenue. Their cash is stuck for 124 days (longer than the 114-day peer median), so faster payment from us has real value to them. Use that: offer 30-day terms in exchange for a price cut. Because we're small, bundle this ask with a longer commitment or more volume to get their attention, and keep two strong alternates warm — Manjushree (₹2569.83 Cr, health 65/100) and Mold-Tek (₹946.50 Cr, health 73/100) — to show we can walk.

evidence.point: They keep 8.5% profit, well above the 4.8% typical for similar firms
We're a very small customer — just 0.15% of their sales
Their cash is stuck for 124 days, longer than similar firms at 114 days
Market research shows the typical ask for a 28 mm PP cap is ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with room to ₹0.65–0.80/pc at higher volume
Moving to 30-day payment frees up ₹2.15 L cash for us
They have zero debt and strong interest coverage of 75.84 times

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter at ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health score 65/100, does pharma bottles and caps — top second-source candidate

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader at ₹946.50 Cr revenue, health score 73/100, strong in pharma containers and closures — a robust alternate

risks: We're only 0.15% of their sales (₹26.17 L vs. ₹179.69 Cr) — on our own we have little pull; bundle volume, commit longer, or show them we're serious about the alternates
They have an EPF payment delay flag in their records — watch for any operational hiccups that could affect supply reliability
Market backups (Reliance, IVL Dhunseri, Chemco, etc.) are leads to qualify — verify capabilities and get quotes before treating them as real options
Their cash cycle is 124 days vs. 114 peer median — they need cash flow help, so the payment-for-price swap is our strongest card
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to talk about bringing our price in line with the ₹0.65–0.80 range we're seeing in the market and moving to 30-day payment — that frees up cash for both of us and keeps this partnership competitive.
